en.askTitle: Change the boxes to your own two offers and see which one leaves more each month
en.runTitle: Austin USD 125,000 or San Francisco USD 155,000: which job leaves a single engineer better off?

fields.label: Offers and cities
fields.value: Software engineer choosing between Austin, Texas and San Francisco, California

fields.label: Start date and household
fields.value: Starting 1 February 2027; single, no children, renting

fields.label: Salary, bonus and equity
fields.value: Base salary USD 125,000 in Austin and USD 155,000 in San Francisco

fields.label: Tax situation
fields.placeholder: e.g. filing single, no other income, no state tax paid elsewhere

fields.label: Benefits and retirement
fields.value: Standard 401(k) match of 4%, putting in 6% of pay, and employer health insurance

fields.label: Rent
fields.placeholder: e.g. a 1-bedroom at USD 1,500 a month in Austin and USD 4,400 in San Francisco

fields.label: Office and transport
fields.placeholder: e.g. hybrid three days a week; own car in Austin, transit pass in San Francisco

fields.label: Debts
fields.placeholder: e.g. USD 18,000 student loan, USD 300 a month

fields.label: Moving cash
fields.placeholder: e.g. USD 6,000 saved for the move and first month’s deposit

en.template: Compare {offers} for {start}, with {pay}, {tax}, {benefits}, {rent}, {office}, {debts} and {moving}. Show take-home pay, everyday spending, retirement separately, first-year timing and the salary or rent that would change the choice. Keep original currencies; do not contact, apply, buy or publish.

phases.title: Check tax figures and city cost sources as of 5 November 2026
phases.note: Tax rules for 2027 where published; rent, utilities, transport and food in both cities
phases.judgment: Where 2027 income-tax figures were not yet published, it used 2026 values and labelled them as stand-ins, rather than passing them off as 2027 rules. The 2027 payroll-tax and California disability-insurance figures were published and are used as such.

phases.title: Build the editable workbook, a one-page summary and the source notes
Recalculate everything, find the break-even salary and inspect the files
phases.judgment: A separate reviewer redid the tax arithmetic band by band and matched the break-even: San Francisco would need a base of about $194,866 to match Austin. It was also open about the limit of its check: it did not re-verify online whether each tax figure was officially published.

workers: Collected dated rent listings and rent-index figures, utilities, transport and food costs for a single renter in both cities
Independently audited the workbook, summary and sources: redid the tax arithmetic and checked the labels

zh.askTitle: 把格子换成你自己的两份工作邀约，看看哪一份每月剩得更多
zh.runTitle: 奥斯汀 125,000 美元还是旧金山 155,000 美元：哪份工作让单身工程师更宽裕？

fields.label: 工作邀约和城市
fields.value: 软件工程师，在得克萨斯州奥斯汀和加利福尼亚州旧金山两份工作之间选择

fields.label: 入职日期及家庭情况
fields.value: 2027 年 2 月 1 日入职；单身、没有孩子、租房

fields.label: 工资、奖金和股权
fields.value: 奥斯汀底薪 125,000 美元，旧金山底薪 155,000 美元

fields.label: 税务情况
fields.placeholder: 例如：单身报税，没有其他收入

fields.label: 福利及退休安排
fields.value: 标准的 4% 401(k) 雇主匹配，自己供款 6%，雇主提供医疗保险

fields.label: 房租
fields.placeholder: 例如：奥斯汀一居室每月 1,500 美元，旧金山每月 4,400 美元

fields.label: 办公室和交通
fields.placeholder: 例如：每周三天到办公室；奥斯汀自己开车，旧金山买公交月票

fields.label: 债务
fields.placeholder: 例如：18,000 美元学生贷款，每月还 300 美元

fields.label: 搬家现金
fields.placeholder: 例如：为搬家和首月押金存了 6,000 美元

zh.template: 请比较我的{offers}，入职日期及家庭情况{start}，工资、奖金和股权{pay}，税务情况{tax}，福利及退休安排{benefits}，房租{rent}，办公室和交通{office}，债务{debts}，搬家现金{moving}。列出到手工资、日常开支、单独的退休储蓄、首年时间差，以及哪些工资或房租变化会改变选择。保留原币种，不要联系、申请、购买或发布。

phases.title: 查证截至 2026 年 11 月 5 日的税率资料和两座城市的生活成本来源
phases.note: 已公布的 2027 年税务规则；两座城市的房租、水电、交通和饮食
phases.judgment: 2027 年所得税数字尚未公布的部分，它用 2026 年的数字并标明是替代值，没有冒充 2027 年的规则。2027 年的工资税和加州残疾保险数字已经公布，按公布值使用。

phases.title: 建立可编辑的比较表格、一页摘要和来源说明
全部重新计算，找出持平薪资，并检查交付文件
phases.judgment: 另一位复核的同事把税额逐档重新算了一遍，持平薪资也对得上：旧金山底薪要约 194,866 美元，才能和奥斯汀打平。他也说明了自己检查的界限：没有上网重新核实每个税务数字是否已正式公布。

workers: 收集两座城市单身租客的房租报价和租金指数、水电、交通和饮食成本，并标明日期
独立审核表格、摘要和来源：重算税额，并检查各项标注
